steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: ...Young man.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: Can I ask the way to the estate of Liang, Magistrate of Shangshu?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Uhh... it's close by, I think. Turn right there and keep going, and once you see the paifang arch, turn left and you're at the Liang estate.

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: Is it spacious?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Who knows, I'm not allowed in.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: But from the outside... I think it doesn't look that different from any other place. Might even be a little run-down.

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: What does it say on the arch?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: I don't remember.

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Hey, old man.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: It's getting dark, how about I show you the way? You might get hit out here.

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: ...No need.

steps.name: Passing Elder
steps.text: I can see the way.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Ugh!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (My foot... it's stuck in a rock?!)

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You've lasted thirty-three moves. Commendable.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You never were pulling your true weight at all.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If you're interested in joining the army, your prospects will surely be bright.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hahah... I'll admit I contemplated it when I left Kou-wu City, but the proverb puts it well: don't bite off more than you can chew. I'll repay Rhodes Island's grace to me for now.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: To know grace and repay it. Qualities hard to come by.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: A shame you're trapped in your situation.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: In a literal sense, to boot.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (If I break my leg, maybe I can tug it out still... let's try it and see...)

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue, I'll assist you!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I regarded this tangle as a farce, and invested nothing in it.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: But you've shown me I was wrong.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You've got less to say now.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You always had so little to say in the past.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue is only silent when going all-out. But when he goes all-out, no opponent escapes intact.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Are you done talking?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'm only speaking to myself.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It's raining...?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: (He broke Shang Zhong's staff so easily?! Before we could even react—how did he do it?)

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: —Who are you?!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: A bamboo hat and raincoat, the rain as your sword.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Excellent kung fu.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Stop fighting. Stop, all of you.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Would it hurt to be a little peaceful?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Not to mention how capable they were. If they were willing to cause a commotion, they'd have won, and come out looking reasonable too.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You're the boatman who was with the Lungmenite since the beginning...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Of course. Liang Xun had two plans prepared.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: He's deceived both the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of Rites.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*... As an official, Mr. Liang has his restrictions. Don't you think the Sui Regulator's been too arbitrary this time?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It wouldn't be the Sui Regulator's first time, either.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: My son died because of you. Don't forget it.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: And why all the fighting for our lives here?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hmph. Sticking your nose into this too. How capable do you think you are?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hahah... making that hat such a permanent fixture always did strike me as awfully odd.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Unless, of course...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Shen Lou, this is Sui Regulator business. It's not yours to interfere in.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I'm just a passing boatman, encouraging you all to stop slaughtering each other here, from the goodness of my heart—

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: —and checking on the state of the summit. Mr. Liang asked me to take a look.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: There were bandits terrorizing the border waterways in recent years. The court sent men to sort it out, cracking down like thunder. With a tianshi leading them, some of the best in the court infiltrated enemy lines.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: In order to avoid alarming the enemy, the heroes pretended to be waterway bandits themselves, stealing into their den, rounding them all up at once.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —But when they came back out, they ran headfirst into a group of boaters who sought to stand up for justice. There was quite some misunderstanding.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: They were hardly lifelong boaters, though, and the boat was just a skiff, approaching the waterside bandit den on its own.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: No more, no more, I'll die of embarrassment... I'm not young anymore, and I didn't want to wade in for a fight like some brawler!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The people only knew that tianshis took the lead. They had no idea that others beyond could truly be calling the shots.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The Imperial Guard drillmaster appraised you quite highly.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Oh, that girl was so young, but her kung fu was incredible. I heard she'd already been helping train the other warriors. She would go far, very far...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But I'm not here today to reminisce.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: An escort like me has only deep respect for you, Master Shen. No matter if it's our first meeting, I'd hear you out.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It's just that we're settling both public and personal bills today, and your word might not make it in... that's the size of it.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But I did agree with Mr. Liang that I'd express some things of my own.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: No matter what the Department of Discipline and Supervision decides afterwards, I'll shoulder the burden. But for now, don't let any dogma here harm our friendships.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: That won't fly.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If Liang Xun sent you, then this can't be as simple as a 'check.'

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You plan to meddle in the Sui Regulator's affairs?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The Sui Regulator just wants to push Tianshi Bai into action. Does it make any difference if I act for him?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Master Shen, I'm on your side.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Friendship is wealth, they say.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Where's your benefactor?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ahead for now.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: That's fine—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Wh... What? Where did that summit and pavilion... come from?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: That's what... we've all been looking for...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Here's hoping we can keep this under control...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: ...Or else we can only resort to violence.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are you aware of what you're saying?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I need your agency's help, young Candleholder. We should be in agreement about the stakes here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are you going to kill yourself?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm not that out of it yet, but... things are getting tight.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Is Its mind not your minds?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's about time we rose up against that giant self of ours.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All nonsense.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What ideas do you have?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Are you willing to trust me?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm only obligated to hear out your idea. Whether I trust it, or not, is the Sui Regulator's decision.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You hold fine tastes, my Lord, to be admiring the snow in the mountains at this hour.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Here, sit.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You knew I would come.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Of course you would come.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: When did the Sui Regulator first seek you?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: A year ago.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: On what matter?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Finding the goblet.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Merely finding it?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: At first.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A year ago, Yan realized something.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Victoria's incidents. Ursus's endless unrest. One of Leithanien's Empresses losing her voice.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All under heaven was in turmoil, and Yan had to prepare.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The court met day after day, and passed the 'Twenty-Eight Policies.' Nothing unaccounted for, and not solely seeking the safety of Yan, but offering survival to the known world.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But outside of the Twenty-Eight Policies published, there were still hidden two more that needed Yan's urgent decision.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Hoh.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What two?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: There are wicked foreign spirits to the north, seas to the south, and ever more hidden dangers from Sui's bestializations.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: All along, the Sui Regulator has advocated for initiative in settling this Feranmut problem.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: The Ministry of Rites doesn't agree. Not at all.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: The High Minister is indeed correct. There lies not only usable talent among those twelve... there are, above all else, several brilliant and virtuous.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But the Sui Regulator's very founding was aimed at sorting out the issue of this Feranmut.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Their opinion cannot be taken on all matters. The Sui Regulator was, at its founding, but subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: It was only the disaster following that game of stones that elevated the Sui Regulator in position.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: *Sigh*... It is a hidden malice of a thousand years, brewing calamity 'til today. To reckon with it is due.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But it's not the Sui Regulator's right to decide, nor for the Ministry of Rites to say.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...The current Grand Tutor?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Grand Tutor has met with that great offender.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Looks like I really did nap too long... So that's what the old guy's like?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: His physique was paper-thin, and he didn't seem like he knew Arts. I thought he was just some random nosy guy, poking into everybody's business.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Grand Tutor mends the realm's affairs, inspecting for leaks and patching holes.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Huh, I thought you'd get angry at me badmouthing the oldie.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Angry?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Would you show anger at a rascally child who blames the sky for raining?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (This boy... he's got a steely tongue...)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (That's the first time I've seen Nian get checked like that.)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Grand Tutor gave the Sui Regulator a hidden aim. Something that must be accomplished, whether or not we openly chafe with the Ministry of Rites for it.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh. And what's that?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Three things.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: It is turning colder.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: The mountains are always quicker to cool.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: This mountain truly did not choose its scenery well. How does it keep hold of its customers?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: How do you figure?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You cannot see the sunset.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: That's fair.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Is it very arduous, that you do so much for the Sui Regulator, my Lord?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's even more arduous hiding it from you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Three years ago, for the Ministry of Rites, I was sent to Shangshu to supervise Ling, who was suspected of settling here.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: And you, magistrate of Shangshu, had more sway in reality than some of your ordinary colleagues, it is true.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I first thought you were inflexible, easily riled.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I must have amused you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: My Lord, for what purpose have you done so much, over all these years?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: My own outlook has never changed.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I do it seeking the wellbeing of the people of my home.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Hesitating not to deceive the Ministry of Rites and the Sui Regulator?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What could be more important than the people's safety?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You know the Ministry of Rites is prepared.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Spring thunder was always the emblem of the passing of winter. I wish not for its clap to reduce the Three Mounts' Seventeen Peaks by yet another.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You are as you ever were, my Lord.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: But you still are not willing to face me, in the end.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: How could I?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: And how could you not? Your behavior is all too clear.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Our ranks are different. Our posts burden us.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But if...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: If you come as no more than Miss Ning, then I, Liang, would be more than glad to.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: So such... openness... is also within your capacity.
Liang Xun lifts his teacup.
No tea is within, but still he takes a long drink from it.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Three things?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: First, retrieve the goblet. We don't know why, but he spilled all to the Grand Tutor as to the cup's origins and rough whereabouts.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And you weren't worried it was a trap?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Second, aside from preserving the two hidden policies, find an even more reliable proposal, to keep this situation suppressed to a minimum.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh... Yan always comes off real cautious whenever you touch on the folk of the realm.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Third...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No matter who they are, should more than three proxies gather on one side, pass on personal handwritten instructions from the Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Handwritten instructions?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So, I ask, Where is Dusk?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Ugh... how did I...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Wh-Who are you...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I forgot about you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Whatever. Someone knocked you out.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Wh-Where's dad? And Shang Zhong?! And that giant bull—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't bother looking.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You won't find them.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: So she could alter heaven and earth in the blink of an eye...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: That woman who suddenly appeared... Just what could her game be?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You're joking! Not again?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Th... They're in a painting?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You wouldn't understand, even if I told you.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: W-Wait, where are you going?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: The summit.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: But isn't the Field of Forgotten Water right th—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —When did... that pavilion appear?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: It came from time immemorial.

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Ao—!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: These things... Is she imitating me with these things, to mock me?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...You really don't know how to cut slack.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is my duty.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I have a question. Just a question, okay?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: If I don't go along with you, what'll the Sui Regulator do?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They'll simply do again what was done a millennium ago.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Moreover, now, we are strong, and your powers feeble.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Hoh.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator's principles are simple. Finish it once and for all, and forever rid the future of plague.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And that's why I'm telling you, we've got the same stakes in this as you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're only scheming to allow yourself escape.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Even if I believed you, why should I believe you can accomplish this preposterousness?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If you can't, then how much unnecessary danger will your existence engender? Doesn't the Sui Regulator have an even more 'dependable' plan to solve this problem?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You cannot convince me.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Looks like we're at a deadlock.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Are you asking me? You could just go ask the one you were looking for.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You must be...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: So this is his supposed big idea?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You're the one who doesn't know anything at all, boy.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: If you don't want three hundred years of standing in the corner, then don't give me that look.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: D-Dusk, it's alright, calm down...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You know how this goblet came about.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hand it over.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You tasked Liang Xun with it, Liang Xun tasked me. If you want the cup, I think you should go ask Liang Xun for it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You understand reason, Mr. Lee. You should know the severity of this.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm sure Liang Xun has his reasons.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If Ning Ciqiu doesn't give a reasonable explanation, Liang Xun will pay for his unilateral action.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Okay, we can dial down the aggression once in a while, little buddy. If the Sui Regulator's so thirsty to have this...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why does the Sui Regulator want this goblet so bad again?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: It's that weiqi weirdo's scheme, probably. He's bored enough to—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: —No... he's not like this.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Is he actually still locked in the capital...? What happened?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The last time the Sui Regulator neared that shrine, a body was discovered inside it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It was Grandmaster Xiang Ru. Heart failure, died while vomiting blood. The weiqi board was empty, save for a single black stone at the center.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Didn't you say you had a whole taboo about meeting him?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator is investigating it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But this goblet, without a doubt, is a crucial key to uncovering his plot. And the two of you, Miss Nian, Miss Dusk...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator wishes for you to come with us.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ahahah, now that's getting a little complicated...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Is he really a step ahead of us?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Why limit yourself to one step?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No wonder the old man was so overbearing.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In that case... how about Miss Ling?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator records that he disagrees with all the other bestials, willing only to recite poetry and make merry with Ling and Shu.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If she still won't show herself, then the Sui Regulator's only option is to—
Do you seek me?
Her gaze is at the setting sun.
Crossing the immemorial, and other times besides.
For in truth, time is a place.
A place only the free and unshackled can halt their step in.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Phew... aaahh... come, look now at this view.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The sun is through, and water runs yet long... while snowfall flows through moonlit vacant sky.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The setting light sets clouds ablaze. How charming, yea, how fine.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: With such beautiful scenery, why still must you persist with such unjoyful topics?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: When did...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Mm, you and your father in his younger years do seem so alike. And yet...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You could turn a blind eye to this, to a sky of endless twilight clouds?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Have you never been alive upon this land?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Okay, keep applauding the sunset in a moment.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I spent a looooot of effort hauling Dusk out to find you, and I didn't do it just to hear you wax poetic.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Long time no see, Nian, Dusk.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Huh? You and old Lee know each other?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Prior to this...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Do such lowly means not insult your character some?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I couldn't get it past you.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: But I never imagined you'd see through me in an instant.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Whose path did you think you walked?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I wasn't banking on truly fooling you.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: And besides, he's the one who daydreamed. The one who met him in a dream was only me.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Isn't this a game I learned from you?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Myself I stay when I awake; the butterfly it stays in dreams.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: But will it be him still, when he comes to?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It is beyond you.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: How dearly rude, Ling.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: If you have the true capability, go bicker so with our eldest brother. Why the cruel trickery on a common human?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Those of different ways cannot plan for one another.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hm? So you and I are of the same way? Why did I not know?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: For how vivid your toast-drinking and revelry was, you're quite merciless.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Which is right. After all, you've thrown away... that goblet I sent you.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Could I ever? It was simply a moment's distraction, while singing to the moons.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I should be the one disappointed. At that time, you had far in advance... laid one stone.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Hmph... hahah...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And what do you laugh at?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Nian's own overestimation. Dusk's timid impotence. Your uninvolvement. And myself, for considering myself so infallible.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: ...You truly wish to substitute?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm? What is it? What are you looking at me for?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: No, it is only me seeing through a dull game.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What did you seek me for?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What, we can't just pay you a nice little visit, Ling?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You fell asleep?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm asking. Did you fall asleep?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How are you able to—

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: When drunk, I simply sleep.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What of it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How did you do it?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You ask how I did it... ah, I understand.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You cannot fall asleep, can you? My poor little sister.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Is it because you fear to have nightmares?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: If it can even be called a nightmare.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Mm... In many years, we have not met.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: So such things are vexing you. And your paintings? Could your paintings not bear the weight of your dreams?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: No... is it that you finally began to feel, that paintings—are but false?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Ah! Hey, don't mess with my paintings!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You bundled all those guys below us into your little world, I'm guessing.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And what for... Crude mounts, parched waters. A heart like unto ashes.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: How dull.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: But these adorable minor scrawls, these I still find so amusing.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What need you feed them?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You should know what we're here to do.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: ...Nian.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: By your idea, where will our course ultimately be taken?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't stare at me like that. I'm thinking about it here, alright...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But right now, I still don't know.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You don't know, then... mm... you do not know.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Not the finest of plans.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Dusk. That scroll all filled with matter in death. It is stagnant, stuck. Somewhat boring. Be rid of it, perhaps.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You don't get to tell me just like that.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Forget not her at the outset, who gave you all true names in one lone word, and what hopes she had for you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Ancient history by now.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What did you just...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Nothing. Only a moment of bliss snatched, away and apart from this world.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The Grand Tutor had something for you to hand to me, no?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This and that are independent. Even once you see his instructions, you must still behave and come with the Sui Regulator.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: All to find him. Find that... basket of blunders.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Oh? A letter?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Your so-called Grand Tutor's instructions... no.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: This handwriting... would it be him...?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The Grand Tutor is an ever stern one. He would never draft instructions in such flowing script... Did he tell you no more?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: My duty is solely to give the letter.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: A letter of the court... the first in a long time.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: ...Heheh.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Is it to us? When did humanity ever get the guts for that? I thought only the True Lung and his little posse would work that sort of courage up.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Then you look at its contents.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hm?

a.text: Affairs come in no more than threes.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: ...One affair no more than thrice, I see.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Okay, I get it. Yeah, we sure do fit that bill right now.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: A fulfilled omen...? That decrepit Grand Tutor couldn't have written this!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: This handwriting looks like Jie's, but she already... could someone else have copied her, somehow? But why do it as the Grand Tutor's 'instructions?'

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It was that basket of blunders. It seems in recent years, he's 'written' no shortage of things.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I thought he was obstinate, that it would only be right he incur Yan's flames... and now this written orders, is another move of his? And why should the Grand Tutor send the letter in his stead...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Unless... the Grand Tutor chose to play white?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hey! Stop mumbling to yourself!
The three lapse into silence.
Though they have existed for so long, the sisters are momentarily stupefied.
The wind blows from primordial to present, this time no longer this moment.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Tha—That's...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I—Impossible... Is even this something he can do...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't ask me...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But, well... even if it's just a reflection... I don't like how it's looking at us.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Dusk, you scared?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't you always have plenty of ideas? Think of something.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, Ling.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: We've gotta band together—what are you doing?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Something suddenly came to me. Last I fell dead drunk, I should have left two vessels of wine here... there, there they are.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Husong? Mm... the flavor is still fine to the nose.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: If you're so cool, do you have any solutions?!

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Solutions? What solutions?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Solutions to deal with It—

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: —A solution to address Ourself? Need I tell you?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're not just going to sit on the sidelines this time, are you?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I hardly could.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: We meet again.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: On this turn, do I dream of you, or do you dream of me?
By her tail, Ling lifts the jar half full of fine wine, and pours it forth into the cup, meant for the one who seems the culprit of it all.
She lifts it to the heavens.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Shall we drink?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I will refrain.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: May you all come one by one, and take your seats,

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah...! What happened?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Where are we?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This feeling—it's just like being in one of Dusk's paintings...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In that case... who are you?
The night parts as a curtain.
A silhouette sits straight within the center of the room.
Behind him is hung half a scroll.
'The Way to Paradise.'

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: If you have nothing to do...

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: What say you chat over a game with me?
